The libraries built into pdf-lib.min.js and fontkit.umd.min.js
==============================================================

pdf-lib.min.js is the browser build of pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT, see LICENSE-pdf-lib.md), and
fontkit.umd.min.js is the browser build of @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 (MIT, see LICENSE-fontkit.txt),
both from npm and unchanged. Each of the two files also contains the libraries it was built
from. Their notices are collected here, because the minified files don't carry them all.

In pdf-lib.min.js:
  - @pdf-lib/standard-fonts 1.0.0 (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2018 Andrew Dillon
  - @pdf-lib/upng 1.0.1 (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2017 Photopea
  - pako 1.0.11 (MIT, and the zlib licence below for the parts ported from zlib)
      - Copyright (C) 2014-2017 by Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn
  - helper functions from Microsoft's tslib, whose notice (Apache License, Version 2.0) is kept at
    the top of the file; the licence's text is in assets/vendor/licenses/Apache-2.0.txt

In fontkit.umd.min.js:
  - @pdf-lib/restructure 0.0.1 and @pdf-lib/brotli 0.0.0 (MIT) - Andrew Dillon's versions of
    restructure and brotli.js by Devon Govett
  - @pdf-lib/unicode-properties 0.0.1 (MIT) - Copyright 2018
  - unicode-trie 0.3 and dfa 1.x (MIT) - Devon Govett
  - tiny-inflate 1.x (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2015-present Devon Govett
  - clone 1.x (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2011-2015 Paul Vorbach
  - deep-equal 1.x (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2012, 2013, 2014 James Halliday, 2009 Thomas Robinson
  - base64-arraybuffer 0.1.5 (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2012 Niklas von Hertzen
  - the browser version of Node.js's buffer module, buffer (MIT) - Copyright (c) Feross
    Aboukhadijeh, and other contributors - with base64-js (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2014 Jameson
    Little - and ieee754 (BSD 3-clause, below)
  - small parts of Node.js (MIT) - Copyright Joyent, Inc. and other Node contributors
  - pako (as above)
